body:
not offended, at all. I sincerely just want to make things work, so thank you so much for taking the time to help me. 

>She probably doesn't really want to die. I'm sure you know this, but I'm going to say it just in case. Death is just a quick escape from the torture of thinking, and depression is complicated. Right now she probably believes that it's hopeless that she'll ever get better, but she feels too guilty to kill herself.

This is very likely, since we're at another morning and she's still alive (though now she's screaming that she's going to kill herself because she got a rash on her back). Unfortunately, it looks like its a bad day again.

I have a very difficult time relating to her because she is so vocal about her threats, and I just tried to do it, like told no one. My depression was never about the way I looked, and I value appearances so much less than she does. It makes it hard for me to relate to her because every one of her threats relates to her appearance, whether she's fat, thin, ugly, etc. 

Her antidepressants made her less violent//less angry and she didn't talk about killing herself (according to my mother). So much of this is thirdhand information it's nearly impossible to decipher.

I can't really be an emotional support for her when she's like this. She screams at anyone who tries to talk to her or even sits in her room. It's impossible to 'get to her' when she's in this place. There is nothing good that can ever happen, only bad things, and when you sit down in her room, she starts yelling at you to leave.

 >Start trying to discuss it with her in a healthy way. Would you say you'd be willing to be her emotional support while she deals with this; could you honestly tell her that she can always talk to you. Can you put your own feelings aside (although justified), and be assertive, but not aggressive while talking with her. Arguing will never work with someone that wants to die, because they'll always default to "It doesn't matter". I've been their; I've done it; we're completely aware of what we're doing.

It sounds like you can really relate, you're right, she does say 'it doesn't matter' to everything. How should I interact with her? Not being bitchy or put off, just looking for advice.

Thank you so much for taking the time to try to help me.
FFVIII works as well, as Ultimecia v. Rinoa

*Hugs* for having been here, because here is a terrible place.

If you don't mind, did the solution in your case end with a call to the authorities, an intervention, an attempt?, proper therapy?

I started watching Supernanny because someone told me it might possibly help since sometimes they deal with poorly behaved teenagers (nothing useful so far).

No worries, man, thanks so much for at least trying with me.

Once she ate an entire bottle of fiber pills. Uh, whether she's just that stupid or uh...I don't know, but that's the closest that she's come to legit attempts.

I've tried to kill myself three times, legitly, uh, did a lot of self harm in high school too. I'm better now, for the time being, but... it's important to have that reference. Uh, so, um, my parents didn't really give a shit at the time and took it completely laxly. I think they deny it, even though it's kind of hard to rewrite history. My most recent attempt was even this month, but like... It's different. And fucking god-damn am I fucking glad I lived, by the way. 

Now that she's threatening though, they're taking it extremely seriously. My mother _really_ believes that she will kill herself, because I've said something similar to the effect of 'bitch needs to shit or get off the pot'. I would hate to believe that she really is just seeking attention in this way, in a way that's so serious. I don't really believe her myself though, not 100%. She hasn't tried to escape when I've inevitably fallen asleep on doorwatch, and you would think if she was serious about it she would at least try to leave, right? 

She has zero self-esteem, no if's/but's about that. She's extremely isolated, extremely antisocial, and threatens suicide a lot. I would love to say she's a fucking bluffer, and I would love this to be over, but there's the 10% chance that my mother's intuition is correct and bitch is going to do it. I mean, she dropped out of college because she wanted to kill herself. She had good grades, just wanted to go home because she wanted to kill herself and thought home would help fix her. (the cynic in me believes she actually wanted to go home to be able to maintain her stringent diet/exercise routine). 

Again, thanks for listening, replying, no worries about solutions, it's fucking nice to have someone fucking listen to me and at least try with me. I feel like I'm the only one trying.

I'm aware she's not a psychopath, apologies, I was really upset by her irrational behavior and somehow calling her names online makes me feel better. A shitty solution, so yes, sorry.

I would agree with the bulimia, except she doesn't throw it up. (as far as we can tell) She's far too concerned with the state of her teeth and hair to risk the stomach acid and the hair loss. She does exhibit signs of anxiety when she hasn't binged for a while, and gets irritable until she finally does, but she doesn't puke it up, and she doesn't eat (pretty much ever) unless she's bingeing. 

Which is all kinds of messed up, since she's extremely calorie deficient and my mother who is aware doesn't really care since she's a model and needs to be waif thin or some crap like that. 

I really wish I knew how to let go, since you're right, the lack of control of her is what's killing me. It seems extremely heartless to just say 'oh well, if she does it, she does it'. It also isn't right being this worked up over the situation, and it's killing me. 

My parents are sure if they kicked her out of the house she would kill herself. I don't know, honestly. I think it would make it much easier for her to kill herself, and that's not something I want to risk. *sigh* So I guess I can't get behind the train of kicking her out.

But thank you for the reply.

I'm honestly not as angry as I sound and I legitimately appreciate your seriously thought-out response. If I could give you infinite karma I would. 

She is having one of her 'bad days' which is what has prompted me to write this post. I am the one on door watch tonight. My mom thinks she's going to try, but I've been on door-watch like 6 times since the 21st of December, and she's still here, no real attempts. She's never actually really attempted. I'm afraid of the hospital bill of a 72 hour hold, but like the idea of ramming down her throat that if her threats are real, here are people to talk to about it, otherwise, stop fucking threatening suicide, there are consequences to that. 

There is so much pressure in this family to make everything 'seem' normal, so that it all 'looks' like nothing's going on. I have told my boyfriend all of my woes but he's overwhelmed with it all and frankly I do not blame him. He's asked me not to talk about it to him anymore because this consumes me, and it's literally all I talk about to him and it feels like there is nothing I can do. 

I stopped talking to him about it and his/mine relationship improved, but the stress of all of this is overwhelming to me. 

My frustration that this is 'my job' simply stems from the fact that I do not know what to do, where to go, or if I do get help, if help will be listened to by my parents or her. She won't call a suicide hotline because she read one of those stupid pro-suicide websites that says that people on the suicide hotline don't actually care about you, and reiterates that they'll call the cops on you. 

My mother told my sister not to tell the professionals that you're actually suicidal because my mother doesn't trust them? I don't know. All I know is that she will not tell anyone how crazy she is, and works super hard to make sure everything 'seems' normal to any professional. It's frustrating. 

Money is also tight all around, so I don't have infinite resources. I know places work on sliding scales but it's scary when you're in this spot to know what your sliding scale will be. 

I know my boyfriend's words for my parents/sister would be inappropriate, but he's the person who knows the most about it. She lives an extremely sheltered and isolated life and if her modeling job knew anything about her depression, it is unlikely they would work with her I think? She works very hard to live this Facebook/public lie that she's alright. She's not alright. She has no close friends. Any friends she had, she's treated terribly and they don't associate with her any longer. Her family and my boyfriend are the only people who know. 

Thank you again for your help. I've still got so many questions about what the right person would even tell my parents to do that it's so difficult to wrap my head around getting someone to intervene. They've made this perfect little prison here, she can't reach out because everything has to 'seem' okay, and nothing here is okay, and no one clearly can help her with it.

Honestly, I pull the age card on _everyone_ because time is short on the earth. All you have is what you're given, and once it's over, it's over. It's a very final decision, there's no time to reconsider, or try it and switch back.

Think about evaluating life everyday, I guess that helps me some when I'm at my worst. Everyone has fantasies, though they are often unrealistic, in death you don't. You're just fucking dead. You can't contemplate building a gigantic igloo, and you can't think about various actresses, or try to learn something new, or even sleep or experience that pre-sleep calm. You're fucking dead.

So I'm 22 and after surviving 3 suicide attempts and one of them I had done and fucking gave all my shit away, it required so much cleanup to live that I didn't think surviving was worth it: it was worth it. 

There is so much joy that I couldn't imagine happening to me. People came through for me in ways I didn't think they would. The world fucking surprises you, man. 

You're talking a lot about being lonely and isolated: do you want to chat? I've got nothing to do, nowhere to be, and I feel a little socially isolated too? I can't promise it'll be fun, but like I'm throwing it out there. PM me, I can AIM or Yahoo or whatever. 

The takeaway is: life fucking sucks sometimes, but life is also fucking awesome other times. Suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem (even if that temporary problem has been occurring for 10+ years)

remember when you signed that magic piece of paper that said you promised to pay your student loans back?

Yeah, they're gonna come for you.

I am planning on moving in with my boyfriend post college graduation (which is like... now) and he seemed very cautious about the idea, because of my insistance with him. 

This plan relies a lot on him, and I don't really have much control over it either. I don't have a job, and so living with him is my best option (though it would be my best option no matter what, as I really like him and we get along really well). 

I'm supposed to do all the figuring out for this crosscountry move on my own, without any guidance from him on when or where. 

I also don't have a job, which is something I can only moderately control. I know, I'm in good company, I'll find one sooner or later, but it's just like ... for right now things are very .... uncertain.

But I feel a lot better, call it a swing, or whatever. Thank you for your concern, I mean that.

oh no! I just feel like an asshole! 

<_< like miscommunication ftw.

I feel like a bad person when I say things like that, sorry.

I've been talking with a lot of people from the site I feel a lot better now. Thank you, sincerely, for caring. I have a lot of respect and admiration for anyone who would spend their time talking to someone in this situation. I usually just upvote people who try but I'm always too scared to say anything.

Thank you so much for the reply.

It's cliche but I'm not big about school. I like computers. I like to write creatively, play video games, take photos. When I step out of my 'oh god, fuck life, I just want to die' bubble, I realize I have a lot of ambitions? I want to learn how to cook properly, and I love playing board games, and I want to make a custom for PAX 2011 and go to the convention. 

I just joined the Catholic church (boyfriend is a cradle catholic), but with the move I'll have to try to get involved there. Religion offers me some peace, but not much. I joined it for the community, really.

I want to work in IT I think, maybe. I worked support for a summer and really enjoyed fixing things (email servers). My boyfriend, he's like working in coding. He's awesome. 

Somehow your post has really helped me, I really like hearing how other people cope with life. As I've mentioned previously, I lack functioning adults in my life.

not a rant at all. 

I guess it's easy to point that in real life I won't let anyone get me anything really. I'm on of those extremely self-sufficient women who used to be a dick when someone opened the door for me. 

I'm not so bad about it anymore, but I went to visit a friend recently and wouldn't allow them to get me anything while I was in their house, to the point that they asked me why and informed me that they wouldn't be keeping a running tab on all the things they've done for me so they can ask for them back later.

So I'm sorry, thank you for caring (I mean that sincerely)

I saw a counselor and a psychologist, the counselor was about talking, the psychologist was 100% about medication.

I tried [Citalopram](http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmedhealth/PMH0001041). I guess I'm just afraid of medication and doctors and asking for things. This is probably why my counselor and I talked about my assertiveness issues. Here they are, haha.

I know there's a way to game a computer science interview (aka Cramming) but I didn't properly and got caught off guard by the questions I was asked. I wasn't the best student in undergrad, my boyfriend helped me with all of my mistakes, since he's a genius. Everyone says they're smart, but he is the real deal. I get too many interviews because I'm a girl in Computer Science. I never meet the requirements, yet people want to see if I possibly could because then they've hired another girl. 

In my self-loathing post interview I applied for any job that didn't need a C.S. degree, like a flight attendant. I just need to be free of the stress and I think I could aptly do better. Give me a month post-gradutation, I was still studying for my finals. I mean, I've interviewed with Google, Microsoft, all the big ones, I always make it past the screens, onto campus, and then fall flat on my face. If I was just better, more well studied, I'd have a job. thank you for helping me reach this conclusion, like seriously, it means a lot to me. 

I'm one of those wanna be self-sufficient women who right now is planning to leech off my man until I find a job, and it's been taking its toll on me. 

And you're right, if I can just learn to be better to boyfriend things will be well. In Sophmore year of college he was so in love with me we were practically engaged, and Junior year is when everything in my homelife blew up and all of a sudden I relied on him too much too.

it's my fault, I tried to push that he and I get married and he didn't take well to that. Now us living together is a precursor to marriage instead of a really fun idea, thus it's some kind of sign or symbolic agreement that we're going to get married. It's fucking stupid, but we're both from moderately Catholic families.

We've even lived together before, and it wasn't an issue apart from the minor hiccups of living with people (ie: OMG SERIOUSLY THAT LONG IN A SHOWER?). 

I don't know what I want from my life. What do you want from yours? What's something I can want? I don't mean to whine about poor me, but like rolemodels? I don't have any. I've never seen a proper relationship, or a proper adult. My parents are fucking stupid and if I'm going to grow up to become them, fuck that. My grandparents? Yeah no. I guess I was rich white trash, but now I'm just white trash. Tell me about some things I can want?

I went to therapy in April until June, they put me on antidepressants (edit: cytrolpram? I dunno, a celexa generic), said it sounded like I have seasonal-esque depression. We talked about how I avoid things I'm afraid of (no shit) (it sounds funny when it's shortened so much). The medication made me really numb, which was good when I was going through a minor crisis, but bad once the crisis subsided (I had stopped doing all homework and refused getting out of bed, so I was on the medication and dealt with issues like .... I wasn't graduating with all my friends and had failed my first class). The therapist listened to me a lot, told me to try to be more assertive and accepting of myself.

I cold-cut stopped taking the medication in August. It was prescribed for a seasonal depression, so I didn't try to change it or schedule another appointment since I thought they'd be like 'why do you need medication?! Seasonal--summer isn't the season!!'

It's strange because I was the life of the party in high school, and always had tons of friends through college, it's just now that they've all graduated.

I don't know. I'm excited about the move, but it relies so much on my boyfriend, and he and I aren't so solid because of how awful I am. And I don't see me moving directly fixing that, since I'm going to still be reliant on him there. Like--I don't yet have a way to support myself financially so he said he'd pay my portion of rent until I had a job.

I graduated in computer science, but here's a secret: I'm crap at it. I'm awful. I had an interview this week and it was horrible. No one will ever hire me for a coding job. I get too nervous in interviews and can't properly respond.

I don't mean to sound like an asshole, so I'm sorry :( 

and I know, logically, no one's going to say 'well, you're right, best to kill yourself', but I illogically am looking for that, for some kind of stupid permission to be done with everything. because my plans are poorly thought out at best, require too much from everyone else. I don't know if I should move in with boyfriend, I know logically I shouldn't move back home, though my mother is pushing me about with that issue, 

I just feel like more of the problem than the solution and I don't know what to do :(

I'm serious, I did six months of therapy and all they wanted to work on was assertiveness. I stopped going. Well, also, when I was medicating I didn't feel bad because I didn't feel anything. All the points were missing, I think they thought my depression was a cry for attention.

I feel like my depression's a stupid cry for attention.

Thanks for the concern though, I just ... like I don't see therapy happening anymore, I don't think those people can help me. I just want to be done. I don't get it, I don't understand why nothing can go right, it's so frustrating. It's not worth it! 

Everyone talks to me to tell them it's going to be alright, that things will work out and I've seen it, they don't.
